task: Grounding Citation Guard, Context Budgeter & Security Filter (EP 11 & EP 12)

features: Full ISecurityFilter interface implementation adhering to frozen AST Type Contract Lock

Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) Sanitizer: multi-pattern detection for HTML comments (<!-- Ignore... --> and prefixed <!-- NOTE: ignore... -->), system role spoofing (system: override, <<SYS>>, [SYSTEM]), instruction hijacking, executable script tags (<script>, <iframe>, event handlers), Markdown and HTML img exfiltration (including protocol-relative // URLs), and comprehensive zero-width unicode normalization (soft hyphens \u00AD, \u034F, \u200B-\u200F, \u3164)

Pre-Retrieval ACL & Tenant Hard Filtering: database query predicate generation and in-memory hard boundary enforcement dropping cross-tenant and unauthorized role chunks, while honoring PUBLIC and wildcard '*' roles for authenticated users
Full IContextBudgeter interface implementation adhering to frozen AST Type Contract Lock

5-Compartment Context Budgeting: System Prompt (12%), User Query (with Vietnamese inflation factor kappa_VN = 2.5), History (10%), Chunks window (45-55%), Reasoning Margin (18%) with strict overflow protection preventing context window exceedance under constrained budgets
Atomic Knapsack Admission: exact 0-1 Knapsack Dynamic Programming, strictly zero chunk slicing or truncation, packing maximal intact chunks within token limit

Bimodal Sandwich Placement: Sibling grouping preserving contiguous document order, placing Rank 1 at Tail and Rank 2 at Head across all chunk counts (including 2-chunk boundary) to eliminate Lost in the Middle
Citation syntax validation supporting [doc-UUID#cINDEX] and [doc-UUID#chunk-INDEX] with post-punctuation attachment normalization
Anti-Citation Laundering: immediate 0 score assignment for factual claims lacking citations
Strict Hallucinated Citation Detection: instant refusal if any cited chunk ID is non-existent, eliminating multi-citation fake citation masking
Joint multi-citation entailment verification against reference context chunks with camelCase and kebab-case code entity preservation
Smart Refusal State Machine: triggers structured diagnostic refusal if any claim score < 0.65
